**hooks:** optional edit hooks, off by default. With `pixel config edit_hooks on` (or `--global`) and a `pixel setup`, Claude Code, Codex and Devin run `pixel run-hook edit-event` before and after an edit tool: the card names the callers a changed or removed declaration would strand, the note after it names the ones still on the old signature. `pixel setup` writes nothing new with the switch off, `pixel doctor` and `pixel setup --remove` know the entries, and every hook fails open.
